subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “They looked at their homes differently afterward.”?
options: Every Mother's Day after that, someone asked, "Did you check the sugar"
But after many years, it can become a record of ordinary days.
She only wanted to give some small things a chance to become important later.
Ordinary things could become history when someone asked their stories.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Every Mother's Day after that, someone asked, 'Did you check the sugar'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「But after many years, it can become a record of ordinary days.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「She only wanted to give some small things a chance to become important later.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「They looked at their homes differently afterward. Ordinary things could become history when someone asked their stories.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
